title: Specify schema validation and versioning
description: Schema version constant, named validation errors, golden round-trip tests. Done when: malformed parts are rejected with clear errors and the schema version is importable and exported.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done: SCHEMA_VERSION (1) is defined, importable and re-exported at the crate root, unit-tested stable. Malformed parts fail deserialization with serde's clear type errors, and unknown kinds degrade to Extra verbatim per the adopted spec (supersedes the older rejection idea) — both unit-tested. All gates green.

right_now_summary: Schema versioning and validation are implemented, tested, and passing all checks.
